meta.question: on CUB, does full rollout keep fewer, more clustered token blobs than late-block rollout because the early blocks smooth the map spatially, and does that clustering cost masked-teacher fidelity (TCKD)?
meta.method: attention rollout split by block range; spatial statistics of the keep set (connected components, spread, neighbour autocorrelation); neighbour-suppressed top-K as a causal control; keep-only masked teacher faithfulness (KL, DKD TCKD); image bootstrap
meta.paper: Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (rollout); Zhao et al. CVPR 2022 (DKD); Allen-Zhu & Li ICLR 2023 (multi-view KD); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD)
